description: Source code for 'git notes' builtin commands, implementing note management features such as add, remove, copy, merge, show, and prune within the Git version control system.

methods.name: free_note_data
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a note_data structure, including note messages and buffers.

methods.name: list_each_note
methods.description: Prints the object ID of a note and its associated object.

methods.name: copy_obj_to_fd
methods.description: Reads an object from the object database and writes it to a file descriptor.

methods.name: write_commented_object
methods.description: Outputs a formatted comment of a git object to a file descriptor.

methods.name: prepare_note_data
methods.description: Prepares note data for editing or creation, including invoking the editor if needed.

methods.name: write_note_data
methods.description: Writes note data to the object database as a blob object.

methods.name: append_separator
methods.description: Appends a paragraph separator to a message buffer.

methods.name: concat_messages
methods.description: Concatenates multiple note messages into a single buffer, handling spacing and whitespace.

methods.name: parse_msg_arg
methods.description: Parses a message argument for note content.

methods.name: parse_file_arg
methods.description: Parses a file argument to load note content from a file.

methods.name: parse_reuse_arg
methods.description: Loads note content from an existing object reference.

methods.name: parse_reedit_arg
methods.description: Sets the editor flag and loads note content for re-editing.

methods.name: parse_separator_arg
methods.description: Sets the paragraph separator string.

methods.name: notes_copy_from_stdin
methods.description: Copies notes between objects based on input read from stdin, with optional rewrite configuration.

methods.name: init_notes_check
methods.description: Initializes notes context and verifies the reference is within refs/notes/.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Lists notes for objects, or all notes if no specific object is specified.

methods.name: append_edit
methods.description: Handles the append or edit subcommands for notes, including editing and merging notes.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds or updates a note for a specified object, with options for message, file, or reusing existing notes.

methods.name: copy
methods.description: Copies notes from one object to another, with support for rewriting and stdin input.

methods.name: show
methods.description: Displays the note for a specified object.

methods.name: merge_abort
methods.description: Aborts an ongoing notes merge, cleaning up refs and worktrees.

methods.name: merge_commit
methods.description: Finalizes a notes merge by creating a commit and updating refs.

methods.name: git_config_get_notes_strategy
methods.description: Retrieves the notes merge strategy from git configuration.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Performs a merge of notes from a remote ref into the current notes ref, handling conflicts and merge strategies.

methods.name: remove_one_note
methods.description: Removes a note for a given object, optionally ignoring missing notes.

methods.name: remove_cmd
methods.description: Removes notes for specified objects, supporting stdin input and ignore-missing option.

methods.name: prune
methods.description: Prunes unreferenced notes, with dry-run and verbose options.

methods.name: get_ref
methods.description: Outputs the current notes reference.

methods.name: cmd_notes
methods.description: Main entry point for the 'git notes' command, dispatching subcommands based on user input.
